_comment: Curated evergreen-rescue list: EXISTING /{metro}/event/{slug}/ URLs that ranked (90-day GSC clicks+impressions pulled and SHOWN per ~/Projects/seo-ops/SEO-POLICY.md) and then died in the 410 lifecycle. generate-seo-pages.mjs regenerates each as a permanent 200 recap page at the SAME URL (no Event JSON-LD, no date claims beyond lastHeld), and the event-seo-manifest `evergreen` array exempts the slug from the edge guard's 410. Inclusion bar: ranked-and-dead ONLY — metrics shown first, list stays curated, never systemic. `match` is a case-insensitive regex against live event titles to cross-link next year's edition when it is back in the dataset; recurrence "unverified" entries must not claim the event returns every year. Note: this list is complementary to data/annual-events.json (/{metro}/annual/ guides) — boston minuteman-library-crawl exists in BOTH (annualSlug cross-references it); the /annual/ page is the year-round guide, the /event/ evergreen page preserves the ranked URL itself.

bay-area.title: Milpitas Red, White & Boom
bay-area.description: Milpitas' city-run Fourth of July celebration at the Milpitas Sports Center: an evening of live music and food vendors capped by the city's fireworks show.

bay-area.title: Hillsborough Memorial Day Parade
bay-area.description: Hillsborough's hometown Memorial Day parade and remembrance ceremony — a family-scale Peninsula tradition with local schools, scouts, and veterans' groups marching.

los-angeles.title: Canoga Park Memorial Day Parade
los-angeles.description: The West San Fernando Valley's long-running Memorial Day parade along Sherman Way in Canoga Park, with marching bands, veterans' groups, and community floats.

los-angeles.title: Los Angeles National Cemetery Memorial Day Ceremony
los-angeles.description: The annual Memorial Day observance at Los Angeles National Cemetery in West LA — a flag-placing and remembrance ceremony honoring the veterans interred there.

seattle.title: Bellevue Family 4th
seattle.description: Bellevue's free Fourth of July festival at Downtown Park: an afternoon of family activities, food, and live music leading into the Eastside's biggest fireworks show.

houston.title: Rosenberg Family 4th Celebration
houston.description: Rosenberg's free Independence Day celebration at Seabourne Creek Nature Park — family activities, food vendors, and live entertainment finished with a fireworks display.

austin.title: Cedar Park Sparktacular
austin.description: Cedar Park's free July 4th festival at Milburn Park: kids' activities, live music, and food trucks through the evening, capped by the city fireworks show.

honolulu.title: Kauai Hospice Concert in the Sky
honolulu.description: Kauai's signature July 4th benefit for Kauai Hospice at Vidinha Stadium in Lihue — an all-day family festival of live music and food ending with the island's largest fireworks show.

san-diego.title: USS Midway Legacy Week
san-diego.description: The USS Midway Museum's Memorial Day-week program honoring service members, with special ceremonies and commemorative activities aboard the carrier on San Diego's waterfront.

san-diego.title: Fort Rosecrans Memorial Day Ceremony
san-diego.description: The annual Memorial Day ceremony at Fort Rosecrans National Cemetery on Point Loma, one of San Diego's most moving remembrance traditions overlooking the bay.

new-york-city.title: Brooklyn Memorial Day Parade
new-york-city.description: Bay Ridge's Brooklyn Memorial Day Parade — one of the oldest continuously running Memorial Day parades in the country, marching down Third Avenue with veterans' groups, bands, and local organizations.

washington-dc.title: Carnival in DE Capital
washington-dc.venue: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library
washington-dc.description: A Caribbean carnival celebration at DC's Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library — music, dance, and family activities in the central library's event space.

boston.title: Dorchester Memorial Day Parade
boston.description: Dorchester's neighborhood Memorial Day parade — veterans' groups, marching bands, and community organizations processing along Dorchester Avenue, a Boston tradition for generations.

boston.title: Minuteman Library Crawl
boston.description: The Minuteman Library Network's summer library crawl: visit participating libraries across the network, collect stamps, and earn prizes — a free end-of-summer family quest around Greater Boston.

chicago.title: Palatine Hometown Fest Family Day
chicago.description: Family Day at Palatine's Hometown Fest in Community Park — carnival rides, food vendors, live entertainment, and kids' activities during the village's July 4th-weekend festival.

chicago.title: Bluey Bash
chicago.description: A Bluey-themed library party for preschoolers and their families — games, crafts, dance-alongs, and character fun built around the beloved show.
